name: Boglioli
origin: A Brescia family tailoring house — pioneers of the garment-dyed, deconstructed jacket.
opview: Positions softness — the garment-dyed jacket — as modernity.

onething.n: official K-Jackets collection — real domain is bogliolimilano.com

notes.ital: The K-Jacket is the argument: unlined, unstructured, garment-dyed, and cut in Lombardy. It reads as Italian less through decoration than through what has been left out of the construction.

cities: Top specialty — Boyds, Mitchells & more · one own shop
